routes.summary: Lists the tenant's activity feed with each event's actor resolved, filterable by type, subject and time range.

routes.description: Audits `sessions.undrained`.

routes.summary: List organisations across the platform, paginated. 404 `tenancy_mode_single` outside multi-tenant.
Return one organisation's admin detail.

Enter support mode for an organisation, pinning the browser session's tenant to it and returning the refreshed session. 400 `support_needs_session` for an admin API key, which has no browser session to pin.

routes.summary: Leave support mode for an organisation and return the refreshed session.
routes.cliExcluded: support mode pins a BROWSER session to a tenant; an admin key has no session (400 support_needs_session)

routes.summary: Suspend or unsuspend an organisation.
List users across the platform, paginated.
Return one user's admin detail.
Block or unblock a user's sign-in. 403 if the caller targets themself.
Grant or revoke a user's global-admin flag.
List the registered agents and their metadata.
routes.description: Requires `read AgentRun`.

routes.summary: The inbox: every ask in this tenant the caller can SEE, newest first.
routes.description:
A member sees the asks of runs they requested, admin+ every run's — the same predicate as the runs list, because "can I see this run" and "can I see its questions" must never be two rules.

`canAnswer` travels per item rather than filtering the list: a member under `approvers: 'admin'`
is supposed to see that their run is waiting on somebody, and the UI renders it read-only.

routes.summary: List agent runs, newest first, filterable by agent key and status.
routes.description: Requires `read AgentRun`. A member sees only the runs they requested; admin+ see every run in the tenant.

routes.summary: Enqueue a new agent run; the route never runs the agent itself.
routes.description: Requires `create AgentRun`. An exclusive agent with an active run instead answers that run with `deduplicated: true` (409 `agent_run_active` only with `?strict=1`).

routes.summary: Return a run with its durable events, asks and artifacts, settling a stale active row first.
routes.description: Requires `read AgentRun`; a member sees only runs they requested, admin+ any run. `?events=0` answers the bare row (no log, no asks, no artifacts).

routes.summary: The same run as `GET /runs/:id`, projected into AG-UI (D7).
routes.description: Plain JSON, not a stream: a run executes in a Workflow, in a different isolate from any request, so live streaming is a feature rather than a mapping — the WS nudge plus the poll already gives sub-second updates.

routes.summary: The same projection, live (issue #7).
routes.description:
GET rather than POST on purpose: `csrf.ts` passes GET, and a third-party AG-UI client can then open it with a bare `EventSource` — which is the only reason `Last-Event-ID` is honoured at all. **`?afterSeq=` wins when both are present**: the kit's own client is explicit, and a stale browser value must never override it.

Everything that can fail is JSON and happens HERE, above `streamRunAgui` — the ability, the uuid,
the 404 for a run this caller cannot see, `reconcileRun` (via `loadRun`, **exactly once, never in
the loop**: it is a Workflow subrequest per call) and a garbage cursor. After the…
routes.cliExcluded: SSE for the browser; the CLI polls the same projection through GET /api/agents/runs/:id/agui (agents logs --follow)

routes.summary: Ask a run to cancel.
routes.description: Requires `update AgentRun`; a member may cancel only a run they requested, admin+ any run (404 otherwise).

routes.summary: Answer one of a run's asks (issue #17). **Eight steps, and each is a precondition for the next** — the order is the design, not an accident of writing:
routes.description:
1. the run must exist and be visible → 404 (another tenant's, or another member's, never exists)
 2. the caller must be an approver for THIS agent → 403
 3. the ask must exist on that run → 404
 4. the answer must validate against the ask's own schema → 400 with the zod issues
 5. `resolveInterrupt` is ONE compare-and-set on `pending` → null is 409 `interrupt_not_pending`,
    which is what makes "two people answer at once" one 200, one 409 and ONE side effect
 6. the timeline gets an `interrupt.resolved` row (`appendEventAtomic`: a steering note may be
    racing a step's emitter for `seq`)…

routes.summary: Send a note to a run in flight (issue #17, decision 4).
routes.description:
It is an `agent_run_events` row rather than a table because a note is immutable, positional and per-run — exactly what an append-only log is for — and the runtime's once-only delivery cursor is the existing `agent_run_effects` ledger, so there is nothing else to store.

`appendEventAtomic` rather than `appendEvent`: this is the ONE writer that races a Workflow
step's in-memory `seq` counter, and the loser of that race would be a silently dropped row.

Allowed while `queued` (the note lands before turn one) and while `awaiting_input` (a note plus
an answer is a normal pair); a settled run is 4…

routes.summary: Runs one AG-UI turn (`RunAgentInput`): adopts or resumes a conversation, replays an existing turn idempotently, and streams the reply through the same path as `/api/chat`.
routes.description: Requires `update Conversation`; 400 `agui_client_tools_unsupported` if the client offers tools, 404 `agui_thread_not_found` for a thread id that belongs to someone else.
routes.cliExcluded: the AG-UI protocol endpoint for third-party AG-UI clients; the CLI talks to chat through /api/chat/conversations

routes.summary: Lists every registry prompt key with its model assignment (if any) and what the resolver would actually pick for it.
routes.description: Requires `read AiConfig`.

routes.summary: Pins a chat config and/or model for one prompt key.
routes.description: Requires `manage AiConfig` (admin+); an unknown or foreign `aiConfigId` is 404 `ai_config_not_found`.

routes.summary: Reverts one prompt key to the default model resolution, removing its assignment.
routes.description: Requires `manage AiConfig` (admin+); idempotent.

routes.summary: Lists the tenant's AI provider configs (credentials never included, only `hasCredential`).
routes.description: Requires `read AiConfig`.

routes.summary: Creates or updates an AI provider config for the tenant, keyed by scope and label.
routes.description: Requires `manage AiConfig`; omitting `apiKey` on a re-save keeps the stored credential, and the first config created in a scope becomes its default automatically.

routes.summary: Deletes an AI provider config.
routes.description: Requires `manage AiConfig`; an unknown config is a 404.

routes.summary: Static catalog for the settings form (what each provider needs, presets, suggested models).
Reports whether chat and agents have a usable AI provider configured, for the Home setup checklist.
routes.description: Requires `read AiConfig`.

routes.summary: Tests a provider configuration with a live call, without saving it.
routes.description: Requires `manage AiConfig` (admin+); rate-limited to 10 calls per minute per IP since each spends provider money.

routes.summary: Lists documents visible to the caller, optionally filtered by `status`.
routes.description: Requires `read Document`; paginated.

routes.summary: Returns one document's metadata and sharing groups.
routes.description: Requires `read Document`; an invisible or unknown document is a 404.

routes.summary: Deletes a document, its chunks and its original file.
routes.description: Requires `read Document`; only the document's owner or an admin with `delete Document` may delete it (403 otherwise), and an invisible document is a 404.

routes.summary: The compact citation form: metadata plus an EXCERPT of the text — never a summary (D18).
A character window over the document's text (pasted text, or the converted markdown of an upload).
routes.description: The window is cut in Postgres, so a 500 000-character document is paged rather than loaded. A document with no text yet is a 409 rather than an empty window — "not converted" and "empty" are different answers, and the viewer renders a different thing for each.

routes.summary: The stored passages in `seq` order.
routes.description: The query names its columns, so `embedding` never leaks.

routes.summary: Who may read this document.
routes.description:
Allowed to the document's OWNER or to `manage Document` (admin+) — the same rule as deleting it, because both are decisions about a document rather than about its contents. A member may only name groups they belong to (`resolveRequestedVisibility`).

Note what this deliberately does NOT do: it never checks whether the caller will still be able
to see the document afterwards. Restricting a document to a group you are not in is a legitimate
thing for an admin to do, and the UI warns rather than the API refusing.

routes.summary: Ingests pasted text as a new document, chunked and embedded for search.
routes.description: Requires `create Document`; small texts index inline (`indexed`), larger ones queue a `document.index` job (`pending`).

routes.summary: Runs a hybrid search over the tenant's visible document chunks.
routes.description: Requires `read Document`.

routes.summary: Uploads a file (PDF, Office, HTML, XML, CSV, JSON, Markdown or text) as a new document, converting and indexing it.
routes.description: Requires `create Document`; returns 413 `payload_too_large` over the upload limit, 415 `unsupported_media_type` for other types, and 503 `storage_not_configured` or `conversion_not_configured` when the binding or converter is missing.

routes.summary: Lists every prompt registry entry with its tenant override (if any) and effective text.
routes.description: Requires `read Prompt`.

routes.summary: Returns one prompt's registry entry, tenant override and effective text.
routes.description: Requires `read Prompt`; an unknown key is 404 `prompt_not_found`.

routes.summary: Sets a tenant override for one prompt's text.
routes.description: Requires `manage Prompt` (admin+); an unknown key is 404 `prompt_not_found`.

routes.summary: Reverts one prompt to its default text, clearing the tenant override.
routes.description: Requires `manage Prompt` (admin+); an unknown key is 404 `prompt_not_found`.

routes.summary: Returns token usage totals per provider, model and feature for the tenant (`from`/`to`, default the last 30 days).
routes.description: Requires `manage AiConfig` (admin+); 400 `invalid_range` when `from` is not before `to`.

routes.summary: Rebuild this organisation's fact tables now, out of band (D31).
routes.description:
It ENQUEUES — a route never runs long work, and a rebuild is a full DELETE+INSERT per table per tenant. The `:15` cron is still the normal path; this is what `pnpm web db:refresh-facts` used to be before analytics left the kit and took its scripts with it, and what `launch analytics refresh-facts` calls.

Admin-level, and scoped to the CALLER's tenant by the context rather than by anything in the
body: the cross-tenant rebuild has no request behind it and lives in the cron.

routes.summary: Reports each fact table's freshness for this tenant.
routes.description: Admin+ only (403 otherwise).

routes.summary: Lists dashboard pages visible to the caller, first ensuring the tenant's template pages exist.
routes.description: Every member; row visibility (D29) restricts which pages they see.

routes.summary: Creates a new, empty user-created dashboard page.
routes.description: Requires `manage Dashboard` (admin+).

routes.summary: Returns one dashboard page's config.
routes.description: Every member; an invisible or unknown page is a 404.

routes.summary: Updates a dashboard page's name, description, config, order or default flag.
routes.description: Requires `manage Dashboard` (admin+); an unknown page is a 404.

routes.summary: Deletes a user-created dashboard page.
routes.description: Requires `manage Dashboard` (admin+); a template page cannot be deleted (403 `template_page` — reset it instead), and an unknown page is a 404.

routes.summary: Resets a template dashboard page back to its template definition.
routes.description: Requires `manage Dashboard` (admin+).

routes.summary: Who may read this dashboard.
routes.description: `manage Dashboard` (admin+), like every other write here — group membership grants READ only, so a member who can see a page still cannot re-share it.

routes.summary: Lists the available dashboard templates (`{ key, name, description }`).
routes.description: Every member.

routes.summary: Creates any missing template dashboard pages and resets the existing ones to their templates.
routes.description: Requires `manage Dashboard` (admin+).

routes.summary: List an app's sign-in access grants (groups and people).
routes.description: Requires being the app's owner or the organisation's admin. 409 `oidc_client_missing` without an OIDC client.

routes.summary: Grant a group or person sign-in access to an app.
routes.description: Requires being the app's owner or the organisation's admin. 409 `oidc_client_missing` without an OIDC client. Audits `app.access.policy_changed`.

routes.summary: Remove a sign-in access grant from an app.
routes.description: Requires being the app's owner or the organisation's admin. Audits `app.access.policy_changed`.

routes.summary: Return an app's sign-in access policy.
routes.description: Requires being the app's owner or the organisation's admin (same 404 as a missing app otherwise).

routes.summary: Set an app's sign-in access policy (`company` or `restricted`).
routes.description: Requires being the app's owner or the organisation's admin. 409 `oidc_client_missing` without an OIDC client. Audits `app.access.policy_changed`.

routes.summary: List an app's access requests, filterable by status (their ids are the approval ids).
routes.description: Requires being the app's owner or the organisation's admin.

routes.summary: P1's decide, retired in P4: an access request is an approval, decided in the inbox with the same eligibility and audit as every other kind.
routes.description: Still behind `managedApp`, so a stranger gets the same 404 as ever; the app's owners get 410 and where to go instead.
routes.cliExcluded: retired (410): access requests are decided as approvals — `launch approvals approve|reject`

routes.summary: Return an app's basic info and where the caller stands with requesting access to it.
Ask an app's owners for access, opening (or joining) its `app.access` approval.
routes.description: Audits `app.access.requested` when a new request is created (201); returns 200 for an existing one.

routes.summary: List approval policies for a kind, scope and scope id, filled in with code defaults.
routes.description: Requires `manage ApprovalPolicy` (the organisation's admins).

routes.summary: Upsert an approval policy on `(kind, scopeType, scopeId)`.
routes.description: Requires `manage ApprovalPolicy`. A group or app scope must belong to this organisation (404 otherwise). Audits `approval.policy.set`.

routes.summary: Remove an approval policy by id.
routes.description: Requires `manage ApprovalPolicy`. Audits `approval.policy.removed`.

routes.summary: List approval requests, filterable by box, status, kind and app.
routes.description: Requires `read Approval`; `box=all` is admin+, everyone else gets `box=mine`.

routes.summary: Return an approval request's detail, with its decisions and whether the caller may decide or cancel it.
routes.description: Requires `read Approval`. A request the caller may not see is the same 404 as a missing one.

routes.summary: Cancel an approval request.
routes.description: Requires `read Approval`; only the requester or an admin may cancel.

routes.summary: Approve or reject an approval request.
routes.description: Requires `read Approval`; who may decide is the engine's own eligibility check, not a CASL action. 403 `not_an_approver` or `self_approval`; 409 `already_decided` or `not_pending`.

routes.summary: Return the nav badge's counts: pending approvals, and how many wait on the caller.
routes.description: Requires `read Approval`.

routes.summary: List the organisation's apps with each one's latest deploy per environment, and the apps domain.
Request a new app, launching it at once if the creator is at or above `launch_settings.app_create_role` (default admin), else opening an `app.create` approval.
routes.description: Requires `read App` (any member may ask). 400 for an invalid, reserved or `launch-` slug, 409 `slug_taken`, 503 `launch_not_set_up` or `app_pipeline_not_configured`, 409 `launch_not_reachable` when Launch is not reachable from the internet. Audits `app.create.requested`.

routes.summary: Update an app's own fields (name, description, etc).
routes.description: Requires `manage App`.

routes.summary: Return how GitHub protects the app's default branch.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Apply Launch's branch protection ruleset to the app's default branch.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`.

routes.summary: Return an app's shared config view.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Re-scan an app's repo for declared config, matching and recording it and notifying on new grants needed, then return the config view.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp` (the app's owners and admins). A scan failure is recorded on the scan row rather than failing the request.

routes.summary: List an app's deploy tickets, newest first.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Approve or reject a production deploy run waiting on GitHub, deciding its `deploy.production` approval.
routes.description: Requires `read App`; who may decide is the approval's own policy (by default the app's owners and the organisation's admins, never the run's own authors). 403 `not_an_approver` or `self_approval`; 409 `already_decided`, `not_pending` or `deploy_run_gone`.

routes.summary: Return each of an app's environments' newest deploy, as the overview's stepper reads it, polling the GitHub run of an in-progress deploy first.
routes.description: Requires `read App`. Registered before `/:id/deploys/:ticketId/…`: `latest` is a word, not a ticket id.

routes.summary: Deploy the app's current staging state straight to production with no release, opening a `deploy.production` approval (pre-approved on the spot by some policies).
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp` (the app's owners and admins). 409 `launch_not_reachable` while Launch's public URL fails its check, since the dispatched run calls Launch back.

routes.summary: Request a grant of a shared resource for an app's environment.
routes.description: The app's owners and admins may call it (the service's own check; the route only guards `read App`). 503 `grants_not_configured` before any row; 409 `grant_already_held`, `values_not_set` or `shared_resource_archived`.

routes.summary: Revoke a grant of a shared resource from an app.
routes.description: The app's owners, the resource's owners or admins may call it (the service's own check). 404 for a grant of another app.

routes.summary: Re-push a grant's values to the app's deployment.
routes.description: Requires `read App` (the service checks further).

routes.summary: List an app's health-check history over the given window of hours.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Run an on-demand health check against each of an app's environments and return the results.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`. Probes inline (two GETs per environment, five-second cap), not enqueued.

routes.summary: Return an app's OIDC client, or null if it has none yet.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Create an OIDC client for an app so it can let its own users sign in through Launch.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`.

routes.summary: Update an app's OIDC client's allowed redirect URIs.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`.

routes.summary: Rotate an app's OIDC client secret, invalidating the old one.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`.

routes.summary: List an app's operations log (deploys, imports and other changes).
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Return the create or teardown pipeline's current view, polling an open wait and reconciling a stale running run against its Workflow instance first.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Cancel a create run that is still running (a stuck wait), so it can be retried.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`. 409 `run_not_running`. Audits `app.pipeline.cancelled`.

routes.summary: Re-scaffold an app that never deployed, from the current kit pin, keeping its repository, database, storage, Workers, sign-in client and secrets.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`. 409 `run_not_failed`, `app_live`, `app_archived`, `app_already_deployed` or `no_run`; also refused (409 `launch_not_reachable`) while Launch is not reachable. Audits `app.pipeline.rescaffolded`.

routes.summary: Retry the latest run of the given kind after reconciling it, when it is `failed`.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`. 409 `run_not_failed`; a create retry is refused like a create while Launch is not reachable (409 `launch_not_reachable`). Audits `app.pipeline.retried`.

routes.summary: Return the app page's pipeline strip: the newest release, what each environment runs, the PRs between with their sessions' titles, the pending production approval with who it waits on, and the candidate's deploy run on GitHub while tagged or staging.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: List an app's releases, newest first.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Cut a new release: bump the version, tag it and record the PRs since the last one.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp` (the app's owners and admins). 409 `release_in_progress` while another release of this app is being cut, `release_version_unreadable` or `release_tag_exists`; 502 `release_github_failed`.

routes.summary: Return one of an app's releases.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Cancel a release's deploy run in flight on GitHub.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp`. 409 `release_not_cancellable`.

routes.summary: Return a release's chain of events: PR, merge, tag, staging, approval, production.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Promote a release from staging towards production, opening the `deploy.production` approval.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp` (the app's owners and admins). 409 `release_not_on_staging`, `release_staging_unhealthy` or `release_not_promotable`.

routes.summary: Retry a release at the stage it failed: re-run the failed GitHub run, re-push a lost tag, or probe health and request approval again.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp`. 409 `release_not_retryable`, `release_stage_changed` or `release_run_in_progress`; 502 `release_github_failed`.

routes.summary: Put an earlier release back on Live through the same `deploy.production` approval as Ship.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp`. 409 `release_not_rollbackable`, `release_production_busy` or `release_in_progress`.

routes.summary: Compare the default branch against the latest release tag's commits.
routes.description: Requires `read App`. Registered before `/:id/releases/:rid`, which would otherwise read `compare` as a release id. A GitHub failure answers `aheadBy: null` with `error`, never a 5xx.

routes.summary: List an app's coding sessions.
routes.description: Requires `read App` and `read Session`. An ordinary member sees only their own sessions; the app's owners and admins see every session on it.

routes.summary: Start a new coding session on an app, optionally seeded from a failed release to fix it.
routes.description: Requires `read App` and `create Session`. 409 `sessions_paused`, `session_limit`, `session_budget_exhausted`, `session_runtime_disabled`, `agent_credential_not_allowed` or `agent_credential_required`; 503 `sessions_not_configured` without `SESSION_WORKFLOW`; 404 for another app's release, 409 `release_not_retryable` for one that is not failing. Audits `session.created` and enqueues the session's Workflow.

routes.summary: Set where a session's Ship ends and who reviews its merge.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp` (the app's owners and admins, the same rule as its deploys). Returns the app detail.

routes.summary: Start tearing an app down, after the caller confirms its slug.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`. 400 `confirm_slug_mismatch` for a wrong slug. Audits `app.teardown.requested`.

routes.summary: Stream an app's thumbnail picture (Live's, else Staging's), honouring `If-None-Match`.
routes.description: Requires `read App`. 404 `thumbnail_not_found` if none has been captured yet.

routes.summary: Queue a refresh of an app's thumbnail.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`. 409 for an archived app or one with no URL; 429 if asked again within a minute.

routes.summary: Start a kit upgrade session for an app.
routes.description: Requires `mayDeployApp` (the app's owners and admins) and `create Session`. 409 `app_archived`, `app_has_no_repo`, `upgrade_no_pin_tag`, `upgrade_not_behind` or `upgrade_open`, plus any ordinary session-start refusal (`session_limit`, `session_budget_exhausted`, `sessions_paused`…). Audits `app.upgrade.started`.

routes.summary: List an app's kit upgrade history.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Return one app's detail, looked up by slug.
routes.description: Requires `read App`.

routes.summary: Import an existing repo as a new app.
routes.description: Requires `manage App`. Triggers a config scan whose `grant_needed` notification nudges the bell live.

routes.summary: Lists the tenant's audit log, newest first, filterable by `appId` and `action`.
routes.description: Requires `read AuditEvent` (admin+ and support); cursor-paginated via `nextCursor`.

routes.summary: Streams the tenant's audit log as JSON Lines or CSV (`format=json|csv`), filterable by `appId`, `action`, `from`/`to`.
routes.description: Requires `read AuditEvent` (admin+ and support); records an `audit.exported` audit event before the stream opens.

routes.summary: Recomputes and verifies the tenant's audit hash chain.
routes.description: Requires `read AuditEvent` (admin+ and support); reports `ok`, rows checked, the last sealed `seq`, and the first broken link if any.

routes.summary: Lists the caller's own conversations, newest by last message first.
routes.description: Requires `read Conversation`.

routes.summary: Creates a new conversation for the caller.
routes.description: Requires `create Conversation`; returns 503 `ai_not_configured` if the tenant has no AI provider configured yet.

routes.summary: Returns one of the caller's own conversations with its full message history.
routes.description: Requires `read Conversation`; another member's conversation answers the same 404 as a missing one.

routes.summary: Deletes one of the caller's own conversations and its messages.
routes.description: Requires `delete Conversation`; another member's conversation is a 404.

routes.summary: Enqueues a `chat.compact` job to summarise the messages outside the history window for one of the caller's own conversations.
routes.description: Requires `read Conversation` and `manage AiConfig`; returns 409 `nothing_to_compact` when nothing is outside the window yet.

routes.summary: Sends a message in one of the caller's own conversations and streams the assistant's reply as AG-UI events.
routes.description: Requires `update Conversation`; another member's conversation is a 404.

routes.summary: Returns cost, token and model usage stats for one of the caller's own conversations.
routes.description: Requires `read Conversation` and `manage AiConfig` (admin+); another member's conversation is still a 404.

routes.summary: Turns one real answer into a draft `EvalCase` for `launch evals promote`.
routes.description: Requires `read Feedback` (admin+); the response marks `containsTenantData: true` since it carries another member's question and answer.

routes.summary: Returns which feature flags are enabled for the current tenant.
routes.description: Any signed-in member; answers from the auth context's already-resolved features, so it costs no query.

routes.summary: Lists every feedback vote in the tenant, the promotion queue behind `launch feedback list`.
routes.description: Requires `read Feedback` (admin+).

routes.summary: Records the caller's thumbs up/down on an assistant message or agent run, replacing any earlier vote.
routes.description: Requires `create Feedback`; a target the caller cannot read is 404.

routes.summary: Withdraws the caller's own vote on a target.
routes.description: Requires `create Feedback`; idempotent (204 even when there was no vote).

routes.summary: Returns the caller's own votes on the given targets, for the thumbs' UI state.
routes.description: Requires `create Feedback`.

routes.summary: Uploads a file into one storage scope (`uploads`, `avatars`, …) and returns its stored-file record; an `avatars` upload also sets the caller's `avatarUrl`.
routes.description: Requires `create File`; 413 `payload_too_large` over the upload limit, 415 `unsupported_media_type` for a disallowed avatar type, 503 `storage_not_configured` without the `FILES` binding.

routes.summary: Streams a stored file's bytes, inline for images and PDFs and as an attachment otherwise.
routes.description: Requires `read File`; a `documents`-scope file additionally inherits its document's visibility, and either an unknown file or one the caller cannot see is a 404.

routes.summary: Deletes a stored file and its object.
routes.description: Requires `read File`; only the uploader or an admin with `delete File` may delete it (403 otherwise), and a `documents`-scope file is 409 `owned_by_document` — delete the document instead.

routes.summary: Receives GitHub's webhook delivery and enqueues a `github.event` job.
routes.description: Public — verified by its own HMAC signature instead of a session. Returns 401 `github_signature_invalid` for a bad signature, 503 `github_webhook_not_configured` without a secret, and 202 `reason: duplicate` for a delivery id already claimed.

body.reason: GitHub signs the raw bytes (X-Hub-Signature-256): the body is verified before it is parsed, and its shape is GitHub’s

routes.cliExcluded: machine-to-machine: GitHub delivers here, signed with the webhook secret

routes.summary: List the organisation's groups, optionally filtered by type.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`.

routes.summary: Create a group.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`.

routes.summary: Return a group with its members.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`.

routes.summary: Rename a group.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`.

routes.summary: Delete a group.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`. 409 `group_in_use` while it still grants access, unless `?force=1` (which narrows visibility rather than opening it).

routes.summary: Add members to a group.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`. Every id must already be a tenant member, and each one's content access is nudged live.

routes.summary: Remove a member from a group.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`. Nudges the removed member's content access.

routes.summary: List the groups the caller belongs to.
routes.description: Any member may call it.

routes.summary: List the organisation's group types.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`.

routes.summary: Create a group type.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`.

routes.summary: Rename a group type.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`.

routes.summary: Delete a group type and all its groups.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`. 409 `group_in_use` while any of its groups still grants access, unless `?force=1` (which narrows visibility rather than opening it).

routes.summary: Liveness probe: reports the deployed version and environment.
routes.description: Public.

routes.summary: Lists the tenant's pending invitations.
routes.description: Requires `read Invitation`; paginated.

routes.summary: Invites one person to the tenant by email, enqueuing the invite email.
routes.description: Requires `manage Invitation`.

routes.summary: Revokes a pending invitation.
routes.description: Requires `manage Invitation`.

routes.summary: Resends a pending invitation's email.
routes.description: Requires `manage Invitation`.

routes.summary: Invites many people by email in one call, enqueuing each invite email.
routes.description: Requires `manage Invitation`; returns a per-email result list.

routes.summary: Lists invitations addressed to the caller's own email across every tenant, for the login-prologue banner.
routes.description: Tenant-free.

routes.summary: Returns an invitation's accept-page details (no ids, no other members) by its token.
routes.description: Public.
routes.cliExcluded: browser-only: the invitation link a person opens from their email, before they have any key

routes.summary: Accepts an invitation for the signed-in user whose email matches it, and returns a fresh session.
routes.description: Requires a signed-in cookie session; an unknown or non-matching invitation is a 404.
routes.cliExcluded: browser-only: accepting an invitation signs a new person in; a CLI key cannot exist before it

routes.summary: Lists the tenant's API keys (never the plaintext).
routes.description: Requires `manage ApiKey` (admin+); paginated.

routes.summary: Creates a new tenant API key and returns its plaintext exactly once.
routes.description: Requires `manage ApiKey` (admin+).

routes.summary: Revokes an API key (soft — sets `revokedAt`, never deletes the row).
routes.description: Requires `manage ApiKey` (admin+); an unknown key is 404.

routes.summary: Returns the caller's profile and, within a tenant, their preferences.
Updates the caller's own name and/or avatar URL.
Returns the runtimes this deployment offers, the caller's own connected accounts and any logins in flight.
routes.description: Requires `read Session`.

routes.summary: Disconnects the caller's own credential for one agent runtime.
routes.description: Requires `create Session`; returns 404 `agent_credential_not_found` when nothing is connected. Audited as `agent_credential.removed`.

routes.summary: Starts an interactive login for the caller to connect one agent runtime, via `AGENT_LOGIN_WORKFLOW`.
routes.description: Requires `create Session`; returns 409 `agent_logins_disabled`, 503 `agent_logins_not_configured`, 409 `session_sandbox_unavailable` or 409 `agent_login_in_progress` before any row is written.

routes.summary: Returns the status of one of the caller's own agent logins, for the modal to poll.
routes.description: Requires `read Session`.

routes.summary: Cancels one of the caller's own in-progress agent logins.
routes.description: Requires `create Session`; returns 409 `agent_login_finished` if it already finished.

routes.summary: Submits the verification code for one of the caller's own in-progress agent logins.
routes.description: Requires `create Session`; returns 409 `agent_login_not_waiting` if the login isn't waiting for a code. The code itself is never echoed back or logged.

routes.summary: Returns the caller's preferences for the current tenant.
Updates the caller's preferences for the current tenant.
Lists the tenant's members, including `support` rows.
routes.description: Requires `read TenantMember`; paginated.

routes.summary: Changes a member's role.
routes.description: Requires `manage TenantMember`; ownership invariants (such as never leaving a tenant without an owner) are enforced by the service.

routes.summary: Removes a member from the tenant.
routes.description: Requires `manage TenantMember`; ownership invariants are enforced by the service.

routes.summary: Replaces one member's group memberships wholesale.
routes.description: Requires `manage Group`; 404 if the member or any group id does not belong to this tenant.

routes.summary: Lists the caller's notifications in the current tenant, optionally unread only (`?unreadOnly=true`).
routes.description: Paginated.

routes.summary: Marks the caller's notifications as read, by id or all unread ones.
routes.description: Returns the number updated.

routes.summary: Returns the caller's unread notification count in the current tenant.
List the sign-up review queue, filtered and paged.
routes.description: Requires `canAdministerPlatform` (a global admin, or in single mode the organisation's owner/admin).

routes.summary: Approve (joining an organisation or minting a new one) or reject a sign-up request.
routes.description: Requires `canAdministerPlatform`. A single-mode owner/admin may only approve into their own organisation, and may hand out `owner` only if they are one themself; 403 otherwise. `new_org` requires multi-tenant mode.

routes.summary: List the OIDC issuer's signing keys with their status and dates, plus the issuer and discovery URLs.
routes.description: Never returns key material.

routes.summary: Rotate the OIDC issuer's signing keys: the published `next` key starts signing, the old one stays in the JWKS until every token it signed has expired.
routes.description: Audits `oidc.key.rotated`.

routes.summary: Return the setup wizard's overview: every step, settings, credential status and identity.
Set (or rotate) a platform credential, then check it.
routes.description: Audits `credential.set` or `credential.rotated`, plus one row per upstream change the check made (e.g. `dns.wildcard.created`). 400 for an invalid payload for the credential's kind.

routes.summary: Remove a platform credential. 404 `credential_not_set` if none is set.
routes.description: Audits `credential.removed`.

routes.summary: Re-run a platform credential's probes.
routes.description: Audits `credential.checked`.

routes.summary: Probe whether `APP_URL` is reachable from the internet right now.
routes.description: Audits `public_url.checked`.

routes.summary: Merge per-agent settings into the session policy (its budgets and limits kept) → `setting.changed` with the effective before and after. 409 `session_agents_none_enabled` when nothing would be left on.
routes.description: New sessions only: every session froze its policy at create.

routes.summary: Where NEW sessions' containers run → `setting.changed`. 409 `session_sandbox_unavailable` when the choice cannot run one on this Worker now (deployed, `remote` never can; under `pnpm dev`, a missing binding or Docker).
routes.description: Running sessions keep the host they started on.

routes.summary: Update the platform's own settings (apps domain, account id, Neon org/region, notifications domain, org).
routes.description: Audits `setting.changed` per changed key.

routes.summary: Set the kit template pin (a tag, a commit, or Follow latest), resolved through GitHub.
routes.description: Audits `setting.changed`.

routes.summary: Reset to the code default: the row is deleted, so the default moves with Launch again.
Check now: the cron's refresh, on demand. 409 `template_pin_not_following` unless the pin follows latest; a GitHub failure is 502 `github_lookup_failed` (recorded on the check, too).
List the kit repo's tags, for the Kit version card's picker.
Readiness probe: runs `SELECT 1` through the request's database handle.
routes.description: Public; returns 503 `database_unavailable` when the database is unreachable.

routes.summary: Return a coding session's detail, reconciling a boot or turn whose Workflow died under it first.
routes.description: Requires `read Session`; a pending merge's reviewer may read but not drive it.

routes.summary: GET on purpose, like the run stream: a third-party AG-UI client can point a bare `EventSource` at it, which is the only reason `Last-Event-ID` is honoured. **`?afterSeq=` wins when both are present**; a garbage explicit cursor is a 400, a garbage header is ignored.
routes.description: Everything that can fail is JSON and happens here, before the first frame.
routes.cliExcluded: SSE for the browser; the CLI reads the same durable rows through GET /api/sessions/:id/events (sessions logs --follow)

routes.summary: Upload an image for a session's next message (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, checked by magic bytes).
routes.description: Requires `update Session` on a session the caller drives, its credential owner on a personal account. 403 `upgrade_session_read_only` on a kit upgrade session; 409 `session_credential_owner_only` or `session_not_active`; 413 over `SESSION_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES`; 415 `unsupported_media_type`; 503 `storage_not_configured`.

routes.summary: Stream one of a session's attached images.
routes.description: Requires `read Session`; a pending merge's reviewer may call it too. 404 `attachment_not_found`.

routes.summary: Ask to raise a session's budget cap, opening (or joining) a `session.budget` approval in the creator's name.
routes.description: Requires `update Session`. When the caller is an eligible approver other than the creator, their approval is recorded in the same call (200, cap already raised); otherwise 202 and it waits in the approvals inbox.

routes.summary: Cancel a session's running turn, or withdraw a message waiting behind one.
routes.description: Requires `update Session`. 409 `no_turn_in_progress`.

routes.summary: End a session from any live status, stopping its running turn or ship if any.
routes.description: Requires `update Session`. 409 `session_merging` while its PR merge is in progress, `session_not_endable` otherwise if it is already ending or ended.

routes.summary: Page a session's durable event log from `afterSeq`, up to 500 rows at a time.
routes.description: Requires `read Session`; a pending merge's reviewer may read it too.

routes.summary: Retry a landing stalled before its release: re-run the merge commit's failed CI, or cut the release anyway past a red default-branch gate.
routes.description: Requires `update Session`. 409 `landing_not_retryable`. A double press retries once.

routes.summary: Return a session's pull request number, URL and checks, refreshing the checks from the repo host when stale.
routes.description: Requires `read Session`; a pending merge's reviewer may call it too.

routes.summary: Issue a short-lived HMAC grant for a session's preview iframe.
routes.description: Requires `read Session`; a pending merge's reviewer may call it too. 503 `previews_not_configured` without `SESSION_PREVIEW_URL`; 409 `session_ended` once the session has settled.

routes.summary: Withdraw a session's waiting message before it runs.
routes.description: Requires `update Session`. 403 `upgrade_session_read_only` on a kit upgrade session; 409 `nothing_queued` when nothing waits.

routes.summary: Resume a suspended session: `requested_action = 'resume'` + a wake → 202.
Ship a ready session: run the gate, fix on red, and open the PR.
routes.description: Requires `update Session` and being the session's credential owner on a personal account. 409 `turn_in_progress` or `session_not_ready`. Audits `session.ship_requested`.

routes.summary: Send a message to a coding session: queue it behind a running turn, interrupt the running turn, or wake the session to run it now.
routes.description: Requires `update Session`. 400 `model_not_offered` or `attachment_not_found`; 403 `upgrade_session_read_only` on a kit upgrade session; 409 `turn_in_progress`, `session_budget_exhausted`, `session_not_active` or `session_credential_owner_only`; 503 `sessions_not_configured` or `storage_not_configured`.

routes.summary: Lists shared resources (`?archived=true` includes archived ones).
routes.description: Requires `read SharedResource`.

routes.summary: Creates a new shared resource bundle.
routes.description: Requires `create SharedResource`; returns 409 `shared_resource_slug_taken` if the slug is already in use.

routes.summary: Returns one shared resource's detail, including its holders and (for owners and admins) its values.
routes.description: Requires `read SharedResource`.

routes.summary: Updates a shared resource's name, description or items; admins may also change its owner group and policies.
routes.description: Requires `read SharedResource` at the gate — the service enforces the owner/admin split, returning 403 `not_resource_admin` for an admin-only change made by a non-admin.

routes.summary: Archives a shared resource.
routes.description: Requires `delete SharedResource`; returns 409 `resource_has_holders` if it still has holders.

routes.summary: Lists a shared resource's pushes, newest first.
routes.description: Requires `read SharedResource`; visible only to the resource's owners and admins — everyone else gets the same 404 as a missing push.

routes.summary: Returns one push with every target's result.
routes.description: Requires `read SharedResource`; the resource's owners and admins only.

routes.summary: Retries a partial or failed push as a new attempt (`<pushId>-rN`).
routes.description: Requires `read SharedResource`; the resource's owners and admins only. Returns 409 `push_in_progress` while one is running, 409 `push_not_retryable` for a push that already succeeded, and 503 `grants_not_configured` without the binding.

routes.summary: Sets a shared resource's values for one environment.
routes.description: Requires `read SharedResource` at the gate; the service restricts the write to the resource's owners and admins (403 `not_resource_owner` otherwise) and returns 202 when a push starts or 200 once applied directly.

routes.summary: Returns the current tenant.
routes.description: Requires `read Tenant`.

routes.summary: Updates the current tenant's name or slug.
routes.description: Admin+ only (403 otherwise); changing the slug additionally requires the owner role.

routes.summary: Deletes the current tenant and its data.
routes.description: Owner only, confirmed by typing the tenant's slug (400 `confirmation_mismatch` otherwise); 404 `tenancy_mode_single` in single-tenant mode.
routes.cliExcluded: deleting the organisation is irreversible and owner-only; the web makes the owner retype its slug — kept off the terminal on purpose

routes.summary: Returns the current tenant's settings.
routes.description: Requires `read Tenant`.

routes.summary: Updates the current tenant's settings.
routes.description: Admin+ only (403 otherwise).

routes.summary: Lists the caller's tenant summaries, for the organisation switcher.
routes.description: Tenant-free.

routes.summary: Creates a new organisation with the caller as its owner and switches the session to it.
routes.description: Tenant-free; 404 `tenancy_mode_single` in single-tenant mode.
routes.cliExcluded: creating another organisation is a multi-tenant signup step (off in single mode); a CLI key is minted inside one

routes.summary: Lists trace runs (`?runId|conversationId|since|agent|status`), paginated.
routes.description: Requires `read Trace` (admin+ and support — a span carries other people's prompts).

routes.summary: Returns one trace's full span tree, by trace id, agent run id or assistant message id.
routes.description: Requires `read Trace` (admin+ and support).
